requirements.text: PersonaMonkey remains authoritative for Persona identity, Firefox contextual identities, routing/Mullvad, userscripts, workflows and browser execution.
PCMS accesses PersonaMonkey only through the typed Persona Broker preserving Integration API semantics.
PCMS modules never receive raw browser.*, raw PersonaMonkey service objects, raw native-host RPC or raw PCMS IndexedDB.
Durable PCMS Account-to-Persona binding uses personaUid rather than cookieStoreId.
Every external mutation has a durable RemoteOperation before dispatch.
UNCERTAIN external mutation state must reconcile before retry.
Dynamic module controller/UI code runs only in Firefox sandbox pages behind bounded authenticated RPC.
Browser/page automation uses PersonaMonkey external execution; PCMS does not create a second userScripts authority.
Module lifecycle uses immutable exact package identity and runtime-generation fencing.
Secret values do not enter ordinary PCMS state, audit, logs, reports or workflow artifacts.
Restore enters RECOVERY_HOLD and reconciles before mutation resumes.
Firefox Developer Edition is the browser authority; deterministic CI pins an exact Mozilla build.

GitHub Actions is the independent verification authority for every non-live phase; P025-P026 were the final live acceptance of the original v1 roadmap, and in the extended roadmap only the final two phases (executionModel.finalLivePhases) require live acceptance.
Parallel implementation is permitted only for mechanically non-conflicting claims with epoch fencing.

PCMS operational authority runs in the extension background context; closing every PCMS dashboard tab does not stop schedules, timers, module work, scans, reconciliation, recovery handling or eligible unattended provider work (ADR-002).

PCMS dashboards and the popup are UI clients; any number may be open simultaneously and opening or closing them never instantiates a competing Core, runs startup recovery, changes RemoteOperation state or enters RECOVERY_HOLD (ADR-002).

Runtime modules installed through PCMS execute immediately; install, update, disable, re-enable, rollback and removal never require an XPI rebuild, manifest edit, extension reload, reinstall or Firefox restart, while package identity, authority envelopes, bounded RPC and generation fencing remain enforced (ADR-003).

Background correctness never depends on ephemeral event-page memory; durable state, idempotent re-initialisation, alarms recreated from durable timers and bounded catch-up are authoritative (ADR-002).
